title: Enhanced G-Quadruplex Stability and Anticancer Activity of N(2)-Aryl Deoxyguanosine-Modified T40214 Oligonucleotides Targeting STAT3 in Prostate Cancer.
authors: Choudhary, Nishant Kumar; Sharma, Swrajit Nath; Das, Gourav; Ghosh, Atanu; Bagale, Siddharam Shivappa; Sinha, Surajit; Gore, Kiran R
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过MD模拟和实验评估N(2)-芳基修饰的G-四链体寡核苷酸T40214对STAT3的靶向抑制，涉及蛋白-DNA互作但非典型TF-DNA结合位点预测，方法含MD模拟，属广义蛋白-DNA互作且可借鉴。
abstract: Signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (Stat3) is a key molecular target in many cancers due to its role in tumor cell proliferation and survival. T40214, a G-quadruplex (G4) forming oligonucleotide, targets the Stat3 dimer and inhibits its DNA binding activity. In this study, we introduced N(2)-furfuryl and N(2)-cinnamyl deoxyguanosine modifications at the G-tetrad positions in T40214 to assess their structural and antitumor effects in prostate cancer cells. A single N(2)-furfuryl/cinnamyl modification preserved the stable parallel G4 conformation. Incorporating either of these modifications into the top G-quartet (TF15 and TC15) significantly enhanced thermal stability. Molecular dynamics simulation studies revealed that the aryl moieties were well accommodated at the 5'-ends without disrupting the interaction with Stat3. It is also evident that H-bonding and pi-pi stacking interactions induced due to the presence of the aryl moieties contributed to the improved thermal stabilities for TF15 and TC15, respectively. Gel mobility assays confirmed that all aryl-modified T40214 G4s form stable 5'-5' dimers, similar to native T40214. TF15 and TC15 derivatives exhibited potent antiproliferative activity (IC(50) = 0.37-0.39 muM) and effectively induced apoptosis while suppressing the Stat3-mediated gene expressions in DU145 cells. Overall, these findings demonstrate the potential of these aryl modifications in T40214 as a promising Stat3-targeting therapeutic approach for prostate cancers.
abstract_zh: 信号转导与转录激活因子3（Stat3）是多种癌症中的关键分子靶点，因其在肿瘤细胞增殖和存活中的作用而备受关注。T40214，一种形成G-四链体（G4）的寡核苷酸，靶向Stat3二聚体并抑制其DNA结合活性。在本研究中，我们在T40214的G-四分体位置引入了N(2)-呋喃甲基和N(2)-肉桂基脱氧鸟苷修饰，以评估其在前列腺癌细胞中的结构和抗肿瘤效应。单个N(2)-呋喃甲基/肉桂基修饰保持了稳定的平行G4构象。将这两种修饰中的任一种引入顶部G-四联体（TF15和TC15）显著增强了热稳定性。分子动力学模拟研究揭示，芳基部分在5‘端得到良好容纳，且不干扰与Stat3的相互作用。同时，明显可见，由芳基部分诱导的氢键和π-π堆积相互作用分别有助于TF15和TC15热稳定性的提高。凝胶迁移实验证实，所有芳基修饰的T40214 G4s均形成稳定的5’-5‘二聚体，与天然T40214相似。TF15和TC15衍生物表现出强效的抗增殖活性（IC(50) = 0.37-0.39 μM），并有效诱导凋亡，同时抑制DU145细胞中Stat3介导的基因表达。总体而言，这些发现证明了T40214中这些芳基修饰作为针对前列腺癌的有前景的Stat3靶向治疗策略的潜力。
